inspiration.character: First-film-era Dumbledore: elder warmth and patient British storytelling, original descriptive inspiration
reasons: Explicit owner request for an original inspired VoiceDesign; Warm rounded elder. Human resemblance and British delivery require listening.
inspiration.source: Owner-authored descriptive inspiration; no performer recording

identity.design_instruction: Create an original synthetic voice. An elderly male voice, about seventy to eighty, speaking cultivated British English with clear non-rhotic vowels and gentle slightly lilting musical phrasing. Rounded warm lower-middle resonance, soft weathered grain and a little airy breath. Calm sustained storytelling, patient spacious pauses, kindly curiosity and quiet reassuring authority. Delicate dry amusement, gradual rises and gentle falling endings. Words are connected naturally and clearly; an older wise conversational storyteller with soft warmth and no booming declamation.
identity.reference_text: There is still time to find the right answer. Let us begin again, and listen carefully.
the difference in the rainbow depends considerably upon the size of the drops and the width of the colored band increases as the size of the drops increases
